name: sherlock
description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
one_liner: A tool that checks hundreds of social media sites at once to find every account registered under a particular username.
buyer: A licensed private investigator or corporate background-check firm doing due diligence on a job candidate or business partner.
business_use_cases: A private investigator runs a subject's known usernames through it to map their public social media footprint for a client's background-check report.
A brand-protection freelancer scans for accounts impersonating a client's name or product across platforms.
A trust-and-safety consultant uses it to cross-reference a suspected fraudster's usernames across sites during an investigation.

money_ideas.idea: Paid one-off 'digital footprint' lookup reports sold to recruiters, landlords, or investigators
Ongoing brand-impersonation monitoring subscription for companies

steal_this: Wrap it in a simple web form plus a PDF report generator, and sell single username-lookup reports to a few small investigation or recruiting firms this weekend.
